sourceSegments.text: Paul, you said that you were obsessed with post-crash, with the debt and the deficit.
The one rule I had for 30 years of trading was never let my obsession with the debt,
and it has been a session since 1994 when I met John Kasich, interfere with my trading because it never,
I felt, would have market impact.
It's funny, I had been short bonds in 21 and 22 because of the transitory nonsense that was being put out there,
and then kind of took a hiatus from that position,
and then in May, I was asked to go back to USC where I had spoken in early 21 about inflation and talk about,
actually, fiscal recklessness, and I looked at these numbers,
and I threw out my playbook

targetSegments.text: 保罗，你说过你对后危机时期、债务和赤字非常着迷。
我30年交易生涯中唯一一条规则就是，绝不让对债务的痴迷
从我1994年遇到约翰·卡西奇以来就一直如此，干扰我的交易，因为它从来不会，
在我看来，对市场产生影响。
有趣的是，我在2021年和2022年一直做空债券，因为当时市场上充斥着通胀暂时论的无稽之谈，
然后我暂时退出了那个头寸，
到了5月，我被邀请回到南加州大学，我在2021年初曾在那里谈过通胀，这次要讲的是，
实际上是财政上的鲁莽行为，我看着这些数字，
然后我扔掉了我的交易手册。
